title: Enriched coend of simplicial modules
statement: Let $A$ be a small simplicial category, let $V:A^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathsf{sSet}$ be a right enriched module and let $H:A\to\mathsf{sSet}$ be a left enriched module. Define the enriched coend $V\otimes_A H$ as the multicoequalizer of the two action maps from $V(b)\times A(a,b)\times H(a)$ to the coproduct of $V(a)\times H(a)$ over all objects $a,b$ of $A$.

source.place: Appendix A.3.3.5, printed p. 871: the enriched coend formula.
